name: dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h1pc-h1pincopy-COMMIT
purpose: UNQUALIFIED default-off H1 output-only registered pin copies, isolate bank fanout and expose direct QN, unchanged cycles EP2/ED3.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc #(.FORWARD_HOP(1), .PIN_OUTPUT_COPY(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_VMBGL_HOP1 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_bgl.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h1pc/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h1pc/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc_h1pc --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_vm_bgl28_mc --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

notes: UNQUALIFIED raw nominal clock prototype only; fresh H1PC actual R and true-period gates plus NP28 full native parent/cost/clock-driver/pin proofs required before diagnostic route. No compensated nearzeroR view publication.
structural_change: Both H2 relocation and generic port-buffer/strong-driver probe leave source-normalized f>370ps/o>270ps. Default-off PIN_OUTPUT_COPY instantiates kept output-only complemented forwarding FFs on ck_req, preserving one-cycle H1 hop, isolating physical FF from E3 bank mux fanout. Complemented output return/state FFs expose direct QN. Generic port buffering omitted after explicit BUF/HB4/BUF; original4f hold drivers restored to reduce larger HB4 load delay. All HB4 hold cells/clock periods/skew budgets preserved. Prototype old H1 nominalR is diagnostic only; actual fresh roots required before any verdict.
